# Outcomes
```{r}
### Readmission
## length (readmission) during the follow-up 28 days since infection onset date 
# Function to determine from which group to start calculation
determine_start_group <- function(start_dates, end_dates, inf_onset) {
  inf_onset_date <- as.Date(inf_onset, format="%Y-%m-%d")
  for (i in seq_along(end_dates)) {
    start_date <- as.Date(start_dates[[i]], format="%Y-%m-%d")
    end_date <- as.Date(end_dates[[i]], format="%Y-%m-%d")
    if (!is.na(start_date) && !is.na(end_date) && !is.na(inf_onset_date) &&
        start_date < (inf_onset_date + 28) && end_date > inf_onset_date) {
      return(i)
    }
  }
  return(NA_integer_)
}

# ----------------------
# Function for readm (KA)
determine_readm_group <- function(start_dates, end_dates, inf_onset, ho_discharge_date) {
  inf_onset_date <- as.Date(inf_onset, format="%Y-%m-%d")
  discharge_date <- as.Date(ho_discharge_date, format="%Y-%m-%d")
  
  for (i in seq_along(end_dates)) {
    start_date <- as.Date(start_dates[[i]], format="%Y-%m-%d")
    end_date <- as.Date(end_dates[[i]], format="%Y-%m-%d")
    if (!is.na(start_date) && !is.na(end_date) && !is.na(inf_onset_date) && !is.na(discharge_date) && 
        start_date >= discharge_date &&
        start_date < (inf_onset_date + 28) && end_date > inf_onset_date) {
      return(i)
    }
  }
  return(NA_integer_)
}

# ----------------------
# Define a function to calculate durations and convert character to Date
calculate_durations <- function(start_dates, end_dates) {
  durations <- map2_dbl(start_dates, end_dates, ~ {
    if (is.na(.x) | is.na(.y)) {
      return(NA_real_)
    } else {
      return(as.numeric(.y - .x))
    }
  })
  durations
}

# Define a function to calculate total duration with the specific NA handling logic from a specified group
calculate_total_duration <- function(start_dates, end_dates, group_to_use) {
  if (is.na(group_to_use)) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  total_duration <- 0
  for (i in group_to_use:length(start_dates)) {
    if (!is.na(start_dates[i]) && !is.na(end_dates[i])) {
      total_duration <- total_duration + as.numeric(end_dates[i] - start_dates[i])
    }
  }
  total_duration
}

# ----------------------
#
df_baseline_01 <- df_baseline_01 %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    start_dates_readm = list(as.Date(unlist(dplyr::c_across(starts_with("readm_ap_") & ends_with("_2"))), format="%Y-%m-%d")),
    end_dates_readm = list(as.Date(unlist(dplyr::c_across(starts_with("readm_ap_") & ends_with("_3"))), format="%Y-%m-%d")),
    group_to_use_readm = determine_readm_group(start_dates_readm, end_dates_readm, inf_onset, ho_discharge_date),
    total_readm = calculate_total_duration(start_dates_readm, end_dates_readm, group_to_use_readm)
    
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(starts_with("readm_ap_") & ends_with("_2"), ~ as.Date(.x, format="%Y-%m-%d")),
    across(starts_with("readm_ap_") & ends_with("_3"), ~ as.Date(.x, format="%Y-%m-%d"))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

###
# total_mv ~ mv_start - mv_end (real mv duration from the data)
# max_mv ~ maximum mv duration
# first28_mv ~ mv_duration with first28 (d28 from onset of index episode)
# max_icu ~ maximum icu duration
# first28_icu ~ icu_duration with first28 (d28 from onset of index episode)
#
first28_progress <- matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(df_baseline_01), ncol = 2)
colnames(first28_progress) <- c("max_readm", "first28_readm")

# -------------------------------------------
### READM
# max_readm
system.time({
  for (i in 1:nrow(df_baseline_01)) {
    group_to_use_readm <- df_baseline_01$group_to_use_readm[i]
    
    if (!is.na(group_to_use_readm)) {
      readm_cols <- grep("^readm_ap_.*_2$", names(df_baseline_01))
      start_date_readm <- as.Date(unlist(df_baseline_01[i, readm_cols]))[group_to_use_readm]
      inf_onset_date <- as.Date(df_baseline_01$inf_onset[i])
      
      if (!is.na(start_date_readm) && !is.na(inf_onset_date)) {
        if (start_date_readm <= inf_onset_date) {
          first28_progress[i, "max_readm"] <- as.numeric(inf_onset_date - start_date_readm) + 28
        } else {
          first28_progress[i, "max_readm"] <- 28 - as.numeric(start_date_readm - inf_onset_date)
        }
      } else {
        first28_progress[i, "max_readm"] <- NA
      }
    } 
  }
})

# first28_readm 
system.time({
  for (i in 1:nrow(df_baseline_01)) {
    group_to_use_readm <- df_baseline_01$group_to_use_readm[i]
    
    if (!is.na(group_to_use_readm)) {
      readm_cols <- grep("^readm_ap_.*_2$", names(df_baseline_01))
      start_date_readm <- as.Date(unlist(df_baseline_01[i, readm_cols]))[group_to_use_readm]
      inf_onset_date <- as.Date(df_baseline_01$inf_onset[i])
      total_readm <- df_baseline_01$total_readm[i]
      
      if (!is.na(start_date_readm) && !is.na(inf_onset_date) && !is.na(total_readm)) {
        if ((start_date_readm <= inf_onset_date) & (first28_progress[i, "max_readm"] >= total_readm)) {
          first28_progress[i, "first28_readm"] <- total_readm - as.numeric(inf_onset_date - start_date_readm)
        } else if ((start_date_readm <= inf_onset_date) & (first28_progress[i, "max_readm"] < total_readm)) {
          first28_progress[i, "first28_readm"] <- 28
        } else if ((start_date_readm > inf_onset_date) & (first28_progress[i, "max_readm"] >= total_readm)) {
          first28_progress[i, "first28_readm"] <- total_readm
        } else if ((start_date_readm > inf_onset_date) & (first28_progress[i, "max_readm"] < total_readm)) {
          first28_progress[i, "first28_readm"] <- 28 - as.numeric(start_date_readm - inf_onset_date)
        } else {
          first28_progress[i, "first28_readm"] <- NA
        }
      } else {
        first28_progress[i, "first28_readm"] <- NA
      }
    }  
  }
})

# For those without ICU, MV, readmission
update_column <- function(df, condition_col, target_col) {
  condition <- !is.na(df[[condition_col]]) & is.na(df[[target_col]])
  df[[target_col]][condition] <- 0
  return(df)  
}
```

```{r}
### (my first successful complicated code!)
# Reintub_date within the 28-day period
# 
for (i in 1:nrow(df_baseline_01)) {
  group_to_use_mv <- df_baseline_01$group_to_use_mv[i]
  
  if (!is.na(group_to_use_mv) && !is.na(inf_onset_date)) {
    mv_end_01 <- as.Date(df_baseline_01$mv_ap_1_3[i])
    mv_end_02 <- as.Date(df_baseline_01$mv_ap_2_3[i])
    mv_end_03 <- as.Date(df_baseline_01$mv_ap_3_3[i])
    mv_end_04 <- as.Date(df_baseline_01$mv_ap_4_3[i])
    
    mv_start_02 <- as.Date(df_baseline_01$mv_ap_2_2[i])
    mv_start_03 <- as.Date(df_baseline_01$mv_ap_3_2[i])
    mv_start_04 <- as.Date(df_baseline_01$mv_ap_4_2[i])
    mv_start_05 <- as.Date(df_baseline_01$mv_ap_5_2[i])
    
    inf_onset_date <- as.Date(df_baseline_01$inf_onset[i])
    
      if ((group_to_use_mv == 1) && !is.na(mv_end_01) && !is.na(mv_start_02)) {
        if ((mv_end_01 < mv_start_02) && (mv_start_02 < (inf_onset_date + 28))) {
          first28_mv[i, "reintub_date"] <- as.character(mv_start_02)
        } else {first28_mv[i, "reintub_date"] <- NA}
        
      } else if ((group_to_use_mv == 2) && !is.na(mv_end_02) && !is.na(mv_start_03)) {
      if ((mv_end_02 < mv_start_03) && (mv_start_03 < (inf_onset_date + 28))) {
        first28_mv[i, "reintub_date"] <- as.character(mv_start_03)
      } else {first28_mv[i, "reintub_date"] <- NA}
        
    } else if ((group_to_use_mv == 3) && !is.na(mv_end_03) && !is.na(mv_start_04)) {
      if ((mv_end_03 < mv_start_04) && (mv_start_04 < (inf_onset_date + 28))) {
        first28_mv[i, "reintub_date"] <- as.character(mv_start_04)
      } else {first28_mv[i, "reintub_date"] <- NA}
      
    } else if ((group_to_use_mv == 4) && !is.na(mv_end_04) && !is.na(mv_start_05)) {
      if ((mv_end_04 < mv_start_05) && (mv_start_05 < (inf_onset_date + 28))) {
        first28_mv[i, "reintub_date"] <- as.character(mv_start_05)
      } else {first28_mv[i, "reintub_date"] <- NA}
    }
  } else {first28_mv[i, "reintub_date"] <- NA} 
}

    icu_end_03 <- as.Date(df_baseline_01$icu_hd_ap_3_3[i])
    icu_end_04 <- as.Date(df_baseline_01$icu_hd_ap_4_3[i])
    
    icu_start_02 <- as.Date(df_baseline_01$icu_hd_ap_2_2[i])
    icu_start_03 <- as.Date(df_baseline_01$icu_hd_ap_3_2[i])
    icu_start_04 <- as.Date(df_baseline_01$icu_hd_ap_4_2[i])
    icu_start_05 <- as.Date(df_baseline_01$icu_hd_ap_5_2[i])
    
    inf_onset_date <- as.Date(df_baseline_01$inf_onset[i])
    
      if ((group_to_use_icu == 1) && !is.na(icu_end_01) && !is.na(icu_start_02)) {
        if ((icu_end_01 <= icu_start_02) && (icu_start_02 < (inf_onset_date + 28))) {
          first28_icu[i, "reicu_date"] <- as.character(icu_start_02)
        } else {first28_icu[i, "reicu_date"] <- NA}
        
      } else if ((group_to_use_icu == 2) && !is.na(icu_end_02) && !is.na(icu_start_03)) {
      if ((icu_end_02 <= icu_start_03) && (icu_start_03 < (inf_onset_date + 28))) {
        first28_icu[i, "reicu_date"] <- as.character(icu_start_03)
      } else {first28_icu[i, "reicu_date"] <- NA}
        
    } else if ((group_to_use_icu == 3) && !is.na(icu_end_03) && !is.na(icu_start_04)) {
      if ((icu_end_03 <= icu_start_04) && (icu_start_04 < (inf_onset_date + 28))) {
        first28_icu[i, "reicu_date"] <- as.character(icu_start_04)
      } else {first28_icu[i, "reicu_date"] <- NA}
      
    } else if ((group_to_use_icu == 4) && !is.na(icu_end_04) && !is.na(icu_start_05)) {
      if ((icu_end_04 <= icu_start_05) && (icu_start_05 < (inf_onset_date + 28))) {
        first28_icu[i, "reicu_date"] <- as.character(icu_start_05)
      } else {first28_icu[i, "reicu_date"] <- NA}
    }
  } else {first28_icu[i, "reicu_date"] <- NA} 
}
```

# Median duration (HOSP, MV, ICU) (for boxplot)
```{r}
### -------------------------------------------
## Hospitalization (from the first onset to D28)
## Keep in mind if the patient died within the 28-day period ?!
### -------------------------------------------
### Change name
# if mortality_date is not NA and < first28_date, this is the date that patient died within the 28-day period
df_baseline_01 <- df_baseline_01 %>%
  rename_at ('first28_observed_date', ~ 'first28_observed_date_death')

# censoring or event # How long patients survived from onset within the 28-day period?
df_baseline_01 <- df_baseline_01 %>%
  rename_at ('first28_patient_days', ~ 'first28_death_days')

###
#
first28_hosp <- matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(df_baseline_01), ncol = 10)
colnames(first28_hosp) <- c("recordid", "hpd_adm_date", "inf_onset", "first28_date",
                            "ho_discharge_date", "first28_readm",
                            "group_to_use_readm", "first28_death", "first28_death_days",
                            "first28_hosp")

#
first28_hosp[, "recordid"] <- df_baseline_01$recordid

#
first28_hosp[, "hpd_adm_date"] <- as.character(df_baseline_01$hpd_adm_date)

#
first28_hosp[, "inf_onset"] <- as.character(df_baseline_01$inf_onset)

#
first28_hosp[, "first28_date"] <- as.character(df_baseline_01$first28_date)

#
first28_hosp[, "ho_discharge_date"] <- as.character(df_baseline_01$ho_discharge_date)

#
first28_hosp[, "first28_readm"] <- df_baseline_01$first28_readm

#
first28_hosp[, "group_to_use_readm"] <- df_baseline_01$group_to_use_readm

#
first28_hosp[, "first28_death"] <- df_baseline_01$first28_death

#
first28_hosp[, "first28_death_days"] <- df_baseline_01$first28_death_days

# within 28-day period from onset of first VAPs ~ hospital stay caused by first VAPs
for (i in 1:nrow(df_baseline_01)) {
  adm_date <- as.Date(df_baseline_01$hpd_adm_date[i])
  inf_onset_date <- as.Date(df_baseline_01$inf_onset[i])
  discharge_date <- as.Date(df_baseline_01$ho_discharge_date[i])
  first28_date <- as.Date(df_baseline_01$first28_date[i])
  first28_death <- as.numeric(df_baseline_01$first28_death[i])

  if (!is.na(adm_date) && !is.na(inf_onset_date) && !is.na(discharge_date)) {
     group_to_use_readm <- df_baseline_01$group_to_use_readm[i]
     if (!is.na(group_to_use_readm) && (adm_date <= inf_onset_date) && (discharge_date < first28_date)) {
       first28_hosp[i, "first28_hosp"] <- as.numeric(discharge_date - inf_onset_date) + df_baseline_01$first28_readm[i]
     } else if (first28_death == 1) {
       first28_hosp[i, "first28_hosp"] <- as.numeric(df_baseline_01$first28_death_days[i])
     } else if (discharge_date < first28_date) {
       first28_hosp[i, "first28_hosp"] <- as.numeric(discharge_date - inf_onset_date)
     } else if (discharge_date >= first28_date) {
       first28_hosp[i, "first28_hosp"] <- as.numeric(first28_date - inf_onset_date)
     }
  } else if (is.na(discharge_date) && first28_death == 0) {
    first28_hosp[i, "first28_hosp"] <- as.numeric(df_baseline_01$first28_death_days[i])
  } else {
    first28_hosp[i, "first28_hosp"] <- NA # NA for wrong number
  }
}

first28_hosp <- as.data.frame(first28_hosp)

# change numeric format
first28_hosp$first28_hosp <- as.numeric(first28_hosp$first28_hosp)

#---------------------

df_baseline_01 <- left_join(df_baseline_01, first28_hosp[, c("recordid", "first28_hosp")], by = "recordid")
```

```{r}
  0
)

#
df_status_d28 <- df_status_d28 %>%
  mutate (
     first28_observed_date_discharge = case_when ( # When the patient discharged in the 28-day period from onset date (date)?
       is.na(discharge_date) ~ first28_date,
       TRUE ~ pmin(first28_date, discharge_date)
     ),
     first28_discharge = case_when ( # Whether the patient was discharged or not in the 28-day period (Y-N)?
       first28_observed_date_discharge == discharge_date ~ 1,
       !is.na(first28_observed_date_discharge) ~ 0,
       TRUE ~ NA_integer_
     ),
     first28_discharge_days = as.numeric(first28_observed_date_discharge - df_status_d28$first_onset_date) # censoring or event from 1st onset # how long from onset date that the patient was discharged (days)?
  )

# ----------------------------------------------------
# combine with baseline
df_baseline_01 <- left_join(df_baseline_01, df_status_d28[, c("recordid", 
                                                              "first28_observed_date_discharge", "first28_discharge", "first28_discharge_days"
                                                              )], by = "recordid")
```

```{r}
      }

    if (df_baseline_01$first28_hosp[i] <= 28) {
      first28_status[i, "first28_alive"] <- 1 #Alive_discharge #d28 ~ discharge_date
    } 
  }
}
```

# VAP patients categorized by resistant pathogens (for Regression model)
```{r}
### Create IDs for resistant bacteria
# ----------------------------------------------------
# ----------------------------------------------------
# CRA
id_cra <- df_baseline_01$recordid[!is.na(df_baseline_01$aci_car) & df_baseline_01$aci_car == 1]

id_no_cra <- setdiff(df_baseline_01$recordid, id_cra)

# CRE
id_cre <- df_baseline_01$recordid[!is.na(df_baseline_01$ent_car) & df_baseline_01$ent_car == 1]

id_no_cre <- setdiff(df_baseline_01$recordid, id_cre)

# TGCRE
id_tgcre <- df_baseline_01$recordid[!is.na(df_baseline_01$ent_thir) & df_baseline_01$ent_thir == 1]

id_no_tgcre <- setdiff(df_baseline_01$recordid, id_tgcre)

# CRP
id_crp <- df_baseline_01$recordid[!is.na(df_baseline_01$pse_car) & df_baseline_01$pse_car == 1]

id_no_crp <- setdiff(df_baseline_01$recordid, id_crp)

# MRSA
id_mrsa <- df_baseline_01$recordid[!is.na(df_baseline_01$sa_meth) & df_baseline_01$sa_meth == 1]

id_no_mrsa <- setdiff(df_baseline_01$recordid, id_mrsa)

# ----------------------------------------------------
###
resist_cols_pathogens <- list (
  cra = expr(case_when(
    recordid %in% id_cra ~ 1, # CRA
    recordid %in% id_no_cra ~ 0, # all no CRA
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )),
  cre = expr(case_when(
    recordid %in% id_cre ~ 1, # CRE
    recordid %in% id_no_cre ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )),
  tgcre = expr(case_when(
    recordid %in% id_tgcre ~ 1, # TGCRE
    recordid %in% id_no_tgcre ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )),
  crp = expr(case_when(
    recordid %in% id_crp ~ 1, # CRP
    recordid %in% id_no_crp ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )),
  mr_sa = expr(case_when(
    recordid %in% id_mrsa ~ 1, # MRSA
    recordid %in% id_no_mrsa ~ 0, 
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  ))
)

# 
anti_treat_01_prior <- anti_treat_01_prior %>%
  mutate(!!!resist_cols_pathogens)

# Add to baseline
df_baseline_01 <- df_baseline_01 %>%
  mutate(!!!resist_cols_pathogens)

#-------------------------------------
#-------------------------------------
### Add None of all
#
df_baseline_01 <- df_baseline_01 %>%
  mutate(nor = if_else(cra == 0 & cre == 0 & crp == 0 & tgcre == 0 & mr_sa == 0, 1, 0))

# relocate
df_baseline_01 <- df_baseline_01 %>%
  relocate(nor, .after = mr_sa)

#-------------------------------------
#-------------------------------------
### WHO priority groups
### Critical group: CRA, CRE & TGCRE
### High group: CRP & MRSA
# Critical group
df_baseline_01 <- df_baseline_01 %>%
  mutate(critical_group = if_else(cra == 1 | cre == 1 | tgcre == 1, 1, 0))

# relocate
df_baseline_01 <- df_baseline_01 %>%
  relocate(critical_group, .after = nor)


# High group
df_baseline_01 <- df_baseline_01 %>%
  mutate(high_group = if_else(crp == 1 | mr_sa == 1, 1, 0))

# relocate
df_baseline_01 <- df_baseline_01 %>%
  relocate(high_group, .after = critical_group)

# ----------------------------------------------------
```
# Categorized by resistant orgs
```{r}
### Categorize the org_type
#
org_type <- df_baseline_01 %>%
  dplyr::select ("recordid", 
          "aci_car", "ent_car", "ent_thir", "pse_car", "sa_meth",
          "cra", "cre", "crp", "tgcre", "mr_sa")

# ----------------------------------------------------
# 1 comes before 0
# NA ~ Any of Big 4 SUS
# NA ~ not Big 4: AB, ENT, PA & SA
org_resistant <- matrix(NA, ncol = 1, nrow = nrow(org_type))

for (i in 1:nrow(org_type)) {
  if (org_type$cra[i] == 1) {
    if (org_type$cre[i] == 0 & org_type$crp[i] == 0 & org_type$tgcre[i] == 0 & org_type$mr_sa[i] == 0) {
      org_resistant[i] <- "CRA"
    } else if (org_type$cre[i] == 1 | org_type$crp[i] == 1 | org_type$tgcre[i] == 1 | org_type$mr_sa[i] == 1) {
      org_resistant[i] <- "PRP"
    }
  } else if (org_type$cre[i] == 1) {
    if (org_type$cra[i] == 0 & org_type$crp[i] == 0 & org_type$tgcre[i] == 0 & org_type$mr_sa[i] == 0) {
      org_resistant[i] <- "CRE"
    } else if (org_type$cra[i] == 1 | org_type$crp[i] == 1 | org_type$tgcre[i] == 1 | org_type$mr_sa[i] == 1) {
      org_resistant[i] <- "PRP"
    } 
  } else if (org_type$crp[i] == 1) {
    if (org_type$cra[i] == 0 & org_type$cre[i] == 0 & org_type$tgcre[i] == 0 & org_type$mr_sa[i] == 0) {
      org_resistant[i] <- "CRP"
    } else if (org_type$cra[i] == 1 | org_type$cre[i] == 1 | org_type$tgcre[i] == 1 | org_type$mr_sa[i] == 1) {
      org_resistant[i] <- "PRP"
    }
  } else if (org_type$tgcre[i] == 1) {
    if (org_type$cra[i] == 0 & org_type$cre[i] == 0 & org_type$crp[i] == 0 & org_type$mr_sa[i] == 0) {
      org_resistant[i] <- "TGCRE"
    } else if (org_type$cra[i] == 1 | org_type$cre[i] == 1 | org_type$crp[i] == 1 | org_type$mr_sa[i] == 1) {
      org_resistant[i] <- "PRP"
    }
  } else if (org_type$mr_sa[i] == 1) {
    if (org_type$cra[i] == 0 & org_type$cre[i] == 0 & org_type$crp[i] == 0 & org_type$tgcre[i] == 0) {
      org_resistant[i] <- "MRSA"
    } else if (org_type$cra[i] == 1 | org_type$cre[i] == 1 | org_type$crp[i] == 1 | org_type$tgcre[i] == 1) {
      org_resistant[i] <- "PRP"
    }
  } else {
    org_resistant[i] <- NA 
  }
}

# NA ~ none of Big 4: AB, ENT, PA & SA
org_type <- org_type %>%
  mutate(org_resistant)

#
org_type$org_resistant <- as.character(org_type$org_resistant)

sum(is.na(org_type$org_resistant))
```
